name: Iproniazide
metabolism: Human metabolism has not yet been verified for this entry. Responsible enzymes, metabolites and elimination routes are not specified. This is a documentation gap, not evidence that the substance is not metabolized; do not infer a pathway from related compounds.
summary: Iproniazid, also spelled iproniazide, is a nonselective, irreversible monoamine oxidase inhibitor of the hydrazine class. It was first developed to treat tuberculosis and later used as an antidepressant before being withdrawn because of liver toxicity.
